itens.trecho: Irrealista e sobre-valorizado. Este filme apresenta o lado menos turístico e romântico da Índia: uma sociedade onde as castas tradicionais ainda são motivo de discriminação, onde os imensamente ricos são poucos e os miseráveis ​​são milhões. Eu não estou na Índia para ver se o filme mostra a realidade, mas deve andar lá perto.

Dev Patel is great here as "Jamal", a young man from the Mumbai slums who shot to fame by winning the first ever jackpot on the Indian version of "Who Wants to be a Millionaire?" only to be accused of cheating.

Slumdog Millionaire is one of those movies that really sticks with you. It follows Jamal, a kid from the slums of Mumbai. Watching him go through so much and still come out with hope makes it pretty powerful. The movie does a great job showing the reality of life for kids in poverty but doesn’t feel like it’s trying to preach.
